summary: Iteration 9 — Live-join enrichment regression. Backend: 11/11 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_live_join_enrichment.py. Verified that GET /api/transactions, /api/receipt-notes (list+by-id), /api/racking-notes (list+by-id), /api/issue-notes (list+by-id), /api/picking-notes (list+by-id) all overwrite snapshotted master fields (description_1, item_category, reorder_level, etc.) AND location fields (godown_name, rack_no, box_no, box_category) with the latest master/location values on every read. Edits applied via PUT /api/stock-master/{id}, PUT /api/godowns/{id}, PUT /api/racks/{id}, PUT /api/boxes/{id} all propagated. Snapshot fields preserved when master/location missing (no crash). Stock Summary and Low Stock regression — both PASS. Frontend smoke: logged in successfully, edited stock_master 3911560/GATES description_1 = sentinel via API, opened Stock Summary UI and observed sentinel rendered in DESCRIPTION 1 cell of row 4 — live-join confirmed end-to-end through the React UI. Transactions list page does not render description_1 as a column (UI design choice, not a bug; API enrichment verified at backend layer). 0 console errors. All test data restored.

critical_code_review_comments: _enrich_items uses a single OR query for stock_master pairs and $in for location ids — efficient O(1) DB calls per request regardless of items[] size. Good.

Reorder_level fallback `(sm.get(f) or 0)` for `reorder_level` when value is 0 will evaluate to 0 anyway — correct, but if the master has reorder_level=null intentionally, it becomes 0 (acceptable convention here).

Box enrichment writes box_category even when bx.get('box_category') is empty string → `it['box_category'] = bx.get('box_category', it.get('box_category', ''))`. This always overwrites with the live value (empty string if master cleared it) — semantically correct for live-join.
Snapshot fields on the document are kept untouched when no master record matches (good fallback for orphaned/legacy data) — confirmed by edge-case test.

Receipt-note items originally only carry part_no/make/quantity; the helper adds 10 extra fields on every list/by-id call. With ~10 items per RN this is negligible, but consider a single combined `$or` query if a future receipt note grows >100 items (currently fine).

Transactions UI table does not include a description column — if user-facing requirement is that 'Transactions History shows fresh values after master edit' for description fields, the column would need to be added to the React table. The data is correctly enriched by the backend; this is a UI-display gap only.
